prompts.name: 아이보리 가디건 여성
prompts.subject: Korean woman in her late 20s, average build, shoulder-length straight dark-brown hair, ivory open cardigan over a dusty-blue plain T-shirt, medium-blue straight jeans, off-white low-top sneakers. Empty hands, no jewelry, no bag.
prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one production-ready EIGHT-DIRECTION pedestrian sprite atlas for a Korean residential alley webtoon scene.
Canvas/layout: 1536x1024 landscape transparent PNG, a precise invisible grid of 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows. Exactly 8 full-body depictions of the SAME adult person, ONE per cell. Cells are 384x512. Each figure centered horizontally in its cell, same scale, head near 40px below cell top, lowest shoe at 480px below cell top. Leave generous transparent gutters, no overlap between cells, no cropped feet/hair. No grid lines, no labels, no text, no ground, NO contact shadow baked into image, no props beyond described clothing/bag.
Direction order is mandatory, read left-to-right: TOP ROW 1: FRONT facing viewer (0 degrees); 2: three-quarter front with nose pointing toward screen RIGHT (45); 3: strict SIDE PROFILE walking toward screen RIGHT (90); 4: three-quarter BACK toward screen RIGHT, most of face hidden (135). BOTTOM ROW 5: full BACK, no face at all (180); 6: three-quarter BACK toward screen LEFT (225); 7: strict SIDE PROFILE walking toward screen LEFT (270); 8: three-quarter FRONT toward screen LEFT (315).
Pose: everyday unhurried walking, one foot slightly ahead, relaxed small natural arm swing, looking straight in the body's travel direction. The SAME frozen mid-stride gait and same outfit/identity rotated around a vertical axis in all eight cells; these are CAMERA ANGLES, not different animation poses. Normal 7.5-head adult proportions. No waving, no phone, no special action, no performance.
Style: polished Korean slice-of-life webtoon background extra. Anatomically credible proportions, clean precise subtly colored linework following each local fabric color, restrained two-tone cel shading, softly simplified faces. Detailed enough for a nearby person, not primitive low-poly, not chibi, not photorealistic. Muted everyday clothing, even diffuse daylight, no dramatic cast shadows. Identical lighting and visual weight for every direction. Transparent alpha outside silhouettes, no white or checkerboard rectangle.
